name: Crêpe Maker Soazig

intro.text: A galette is buckwheat, savoury. A crêpe is wheat, sweet. Confuse them and we battle. You've confused them. We battle.

win: Bon. You may have a crêpe.
after: Buckwheat, blé noir, grows well in Brittany's poor, acid soils, which is why the savoury galette became a Breton staple.
